title: The Power of Linking Words
text:
Linking words help a reader follow the ideas in a text. Words such as however, therefore and moreover show how one sentence relates to the next. Without them, a text can seem like a list of unrelated facts. For this reason, good writers use connectors carefully, not just to decorate their sentences.

Connectors can be grouped by their function. Some add information, such as furthermore, while others show contrast, such as however and although. Students often overuse simple words like and and but, so teachers recommend learning more precise alternatives. Varying the connectors makes writing more sophisticated and easier to follow.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do linking words help the reader do?
options: Follow the ideas in a text
Translate the text into another language

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do teachers recommend?
options: Learning more precise alternatives to simple connectors

questions.text: Why might a text without linking words seem difficult to follow?
options: Its sentences would be too long
The relationships between ideas would be unclear
It would contain too many technical terms
It would be written in the passive voice

questions.text: What can the reader most likely conclude about students who overuse 'and' and 'but'?
options: Their writing may sound repetitive and less varied
They understand contrast better than other students
They are unable to read English texts
They always write in a formal style

vocabulary.definition: words that link ideas in a text
in addition to what has been said

paragraph_translations: Сполучники допомагають читачеві стежити за думками в тексті. Такі слова, як «однак», «отже» і «крім того», показують, як одне речення пов'язане з наступним. Без них текст може здаватися списком не пов'язаних між собою фактів. Тому хороші автори використовують сполучники обережно, а не лише для прикраси речень.

Сполучники можна згрупувати за їхньою функцією. Одні додають інформацію, як «крім того», а інші показують контраст, як «однак» і «хоча». Учні часто надмірно використовують прості слова «і» та «але», тому викладачі радять вивчати точніші альтернативи. Різноманітність сполучників робить письмо більш витонченим і легшим для розуміння.
